pg02.intro: Three party breakers have tripped. Flip them back, then take the stairwell up to the midway. Balloons will not hurt you. The people holding them might.

stagesAdd.text: Take the stairwell to the midway

pg05.description: A narrow stairwell the colour of boiled sweets, climbing eight floors in a single shaft. Every flight turns back on itself, and the door at the top is the only way out.
pg05.intro: One narrow stairwell between you and the top, eight flights of it. It turns back on itself on every landing. Keep moving.

stagesAdd.text: Climb the shaft to the top

pg10.description: Six storeys of mall atrium whose escalators all stop at the wrong floor. The only way up is the stairwell in the service core: one narrow shaft, six flights.
pg10.intro: The escalators are stopping at the wrong floors. Take the stairwell: one shaft, six flights to the top of the atrium.

stagesAdd.text: Take the stairwell to the sixth floor

pg15.intro: Blow out the three birthday cakes and take the service stairwell up. The guests will notice.

pg16.description: One great stairwell in candy-cane stripes: twelve flights in a single narrow shaft, turning back on itself all the way to the top. There is nothing else in the tower.
pg16.intro: One narrow shaft, twelve flights, and things that join you partway up. Do not stop to count the floors.

stagesAdd.text: Climb the great stairwell to the top

pg21.intro: Find the two fun house keys in the glass rooms, then climb the stairwell out. The glass is thinner than it looks.

pg25.intro: Throw the two float breakers and take the subway stairwell up. Everyone on the rooftops is waving.

pg27.description: A stairwell tower that goes on past any building: one narrow shaft, sixteen flights, and no doors but the one at the top.
pg27.intro: Sixteen flights in one narrow shaft, all the way to the top. Do not look down. Do not look up either.

stagesAdd.text: Climb the shaft to the top
